purpose: A factual ledger for projections and research prioritisation. A retained mechanism win, a targeted application result, and a full-corpus result are separate evidence classes.

headline.caveat: Portfolio 26 is a preserved Silesia result. The frozen full-enwik9 p26 attempt was cancelled before a complete archive/decode and has no score.

wikipedia_count_feedback.candidate: paid high-nibble-context successor composition feedback with arithmetic residual coding
wikipedia_count_feedback.matched_control: same causal high-nibble context arithmetic without future composition; physical framing and composition vectors charged
wikipedia_count_feedback.interpretation: This retains a paid predictive-information mechanism at bounded scale. It is not PAQ, not a full Wikipedia archive, and not evidence that rank coding beats matched arithmetic. The observed percentage shrank with contiguous scale.

matched_coding_controlled_microbenchmark.candidate: exact constrained-order ranks versus matched conditioned arithmetic
matched_coding_controlled_microbenchmark.result: On the 80-frame Markov/Euler tournament, ranks beat independent-row coding in 5 cases and matched conditioned arithmetic in 1 case; all 80 frames round-trip.

exact_one_byte_winner.fixture: osdb-high-nibble: fixed 256-byte high-nibble projection of Silesia osdb bytes 65536..65791
exact_one_byte_winner.same_information: both constrained modes transmit identical alphabet, transition counts, endpoints and valid-completion constraints

matched_coding_controlled_microbenchmark.interpretation: The 80-frame tournament is synthetic. The exact one-byte result is instead a controlled 256-byte projection of a Silesia osdb range. Both are narrow coding diagnostics: most same-information comparisons tie or favor arithmetic after framing, and neither establishes generic rank-coder superiority or a Wikipedia gain.

projection_rules: Do not add regional or synthetic savings to form a full-enwik9 score.
A synthetic win establishes a mechanism; a targeted real win establishes application evidence; only completed full archives establish full-file size.
Silesia specialisation and backend changes are not evidence that the same mechanism transfers to Wikipedia.
No current evidence establishes a complete Hutter archive, package size, score, eligibility, or submission.
